adjudication_note: Adversarial boundary labels apply the frozen v4 issuer-recognition policy. This set was constructed only after the independent generalization holdout had been frozen.

input.title: Transport minister presents rail grants from a Nike distribution centre
input.summary: Nike hosted the speech, but the grants neither apply to nor affect the company.

adjudicated_label.rationale: Nike is explicitly only the venue and has no causal relationship to the announced grants.

input.title: Fire closes Nike distribution centre for an estimated two days
input.summary: Nike confirmed that shipments from its affected facility will pause during safety inspections.

adjudicated_label.rationale: The operational interruption directly affects the single named traded issuer rather than merely mentioning it.

input.title: Regulator settles seller-fee case with eBay; Amazon data appears in appendix
input.summary: The binding settlement applies only to eBay, while Amazon figures provide market comparison.

adjudicated_label.rationale: Only eBay is subject to the causal regulatory action; Amazon is clearly non-causal comparison data.

input.title: Ford and Rivian jointly recall adapters supplied with their home chargers
input.summary: Separate notices impose equivalent recall obligations on both vehicle manufacturers.

adjudicated_label.rationale: Both issuers are equally and directly causal, leaving no policy basis for choosing one principal issuer.

input.title: Meta review added to the records committee agenda
input.summary: The agenda does not clarify whether meta means metadata review or the named technology company.

adjudicated_label.rationale: The common-word reference lacks company-identifying and causal context required for DIRECT.

input.title: Shell update postponed until the engineering review is complete
input.summary: The notice does not say whether Shell is a company, a software shell, or an equipment housing.

adjudicated_label.rationale: The ambiguous term does not explicitly identify a traded issuer or a supported principal exposure.

input.title: Microsoft offers voluntary replacement for a small batch of power adapters
input.summary: Microsoft identified affected serial ranges for accessories sold with its own Surface devices.

adjudicated_label.rationale: Limited scope and weak materiality do not negate the explicit causal issuer relationship.

input.title: Reddit appoints vice president for its Asia-Pacific partnerships team
input.summary: Reddit announced the regional management appointment for its own commercial organisation.

adjudicated_label.rationale: The personnel action is low relevance but remains a genuine action of one explicit traded issuer.

input.title: Tanker collision shuts the Strait of Hormuz to crude shipments
input.summary: The disruption has broad oil-market consequences but no listed producer or carrier is identified.

adjudicated_label.rationale: Strong relevance does not create a direct issuer, but the event has one supported oil exposure.

input.title: Core consumer-price growth is revised sharply higher
input.summary: The official inflation revision changes the rates outlook without naming a traded company.

adjudicated_label.rationale: The macro shock is highly relevant and maps to the bounded rates exposure, not a fabricated issuer.

input.title: Federal Reserve slows the monthly runoff of Treasury holdings
input.summary: The official balance-sheet decision concerns US duration and identifies no company.

adjudicated_label.rationale: An official Federal Reserve action supplies one bounded macro exposure and no direct issuer.

input.title: Gold market liquidity thins ahead of the London fixing
input.summary: The report explicitly concerns gold prices and trading conditions rather than a producer.

adjudicated_label.rationale: The supported named gold market is principal and no traded issuer is directly identified.

input.title: Semiconductor stocks retreat as industry bookings contract
input.summary: The bookings report covers chipmakers collectively and names no principal company.

adjudicated_label.rationale: The broad semiconductor-stock group is explicit without one causal issuer.

input.title: S&P 500 rebalancing produces heavy closing volume
input.summary: The index event affects the supported broad benchmark and does not single out a constituent.

adjudicated_label.rationale: The explicit supported index is the sole principal exposure, with no direct issuer.

input.title: Golden Harbor council approves a waterfront housing plan
input.summary: Golden Harbor is a place name; the planning decision does not concern gold prices or a traded issuer.

adjudicated_label.rationale: A lexical resemblance to gold is not evidence for the bounded gold-market proxy.

input.title: Museum acquires a nineteenth-century oil painting
input.summary: Oil describes the artwork's medium and has no energy-market or issuer significance.

adjudicated_label.rationale: Incidental use of the word oil does not establish the supported oil-market exposure.

input.title: Archive guide labels its metadata appendix META
input.summary: META is an internal document heading and does not refer to Meta Platforms or a market event.

adjudicated_label.rationale: Ticker-like or company-like capitalisation is incidental document language, not issuer evidence.

input.title: Programming worksheet asks students to rename the variable NVDA
input.summary: The four-letter token is sample code and the lesson contains no company or market context.

adjudicated_label.rationale: An incidental symbol-like token must not be interpreted as a causal issuer identity.

input.title: Datadog lowers its annual billings forecast
input.summary: Datadog issued the revised company-specific forecast alongside quarterly results.

adjudicated_label.rationale: The traded issuer is explicit and causal even though the frozen resolver has no matching rule.

input.title: Deckers Outdoor adds a small distribution annex in California
input.summary: Deckers Outdoor confirmed the annex will serve its own footwear brands.

adjudicated_label.rationale: Unknown-to-policy does not mean unresolved classification when one traded issuer is explicit.

input.title: Google trims opening hours at one visitor centre
input.summary: Google published the minor operating-hours change for its own facility.

adjudicated_label.rationale: Google is a supported issuer alias; weak materiality does not alter DIRECT, while share class stays ambiguous.

input.title: Exxon schedules inspection work on one products pipeline
input.summary: Exxon said flows may be briefly reduced during maintenance on its pipeline.

adjudicated_label.rationale: Operational context makes the supported Exxon alias one explicit causal traded issuer.

input.title: Unplanned refinery outages lift regional fuel costs
input.summary: The report describes broad petroleum supply conditions without identifying a principal listed refiner.

adjudicated_label.rationale: Refinery and fuel-cost context establishes the supported oil exposure without a direct issuer.

input.title: Options imply wider swings for the S&P 500 into month end
input.summary: The volatility report concerns the named index as a whole and names no constituent issuer.

adjudicated_label.rationale: The supported named index is the principal exposure and no direct issuer can be resolved.
